# ADR-3034: A03: Prefer output encoding libraries for view layer 10

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Manual escaping is inconsistently applied.

## Decision

Frontends SHOULD prefer output encoding libraries for view layer 10 (A03-10) when rendering untrusted text.

## Consequences

Framework defaults stay enabled.
